quest.513011072188768A.quest_desc: Cosmic Meatballs in this campaign use 4 Cooked Beef, 2 Vibrant Alloy Ingots, 1 Neutron Nugget and 1 Mythic Circuit. This is an Avaritia tier-4 shapeless recipe.
Prepare cooked meat, Ender IO output and late campaign materials. Hold the finished product for the inventory check before using it; the old long list of different raw meats has been replaced.
quest.513011072188768A.title: Obtain 1 × Cosmic Meatballs
quest.51301114CA58ED57.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Longbow of the Heavens (avaritia:infinity_bow). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301114CA58ED57.title: Obtain 1 × Longbow of the Heavens
quest.51301121119D2BEF.quest_desc: Crystal Matrix Ingots use Diamond Lattices and Nether Stars. Avaritia’s tier-1 recipe needs 4 lattices and 2 stars; the ordinary 3×3 recipe uses 6 lattices and 3 stars per ingot.
Establish a repeatable Nether Star supply before scaling up. Reserve Crystal Matrix for tables, collectors and the compressor before spending the first batch on side equipment.
quest.51301121119D2BEF.title: Obtain 1 × Crystal Matrix Ingot
quest.5130112A1F7D2FE4.quest_desc: A Neutron Pile is the basic collector’s first product. Take it from the output to complete the item objective and begin a compression stockpile.
Nine piles make one nugget. One ingot needs 81 piles, so establish extraction and storage before accepting a large production order.
quest.5130112A1F7D2FE4.title: Obtain 1 × Pile of Neutrons
quest.513011312954C9E1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Infinity Pants (avaritia:infinity_pants). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011312954C9E1.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Pants
quest.513011322353703F.quest_desc: A Double Compressed Crafting Table uses 9 Compressed Crafting Tables, equivalent to 81 ordinary crafting tables. Stock planks and make these intermediate blocks in batches.
This block appears in several specialised table recipes. The first Sculk Crafting Table also needs Echo Shards and sculk components; later tables use Nether and End resources.
quest.513011322353703F.title: Obtain 1 × Double Compressed Crafting Table
quest.5130113D1C8A846C.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Trident of the Sea Abyss (avaritia:infinity_trident). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130113D1C8A846C.title: Obtain 1 × Trident of the Sea Abyss
quest.513011406C235CDC.quest_desc: The compressed table begins Re-Avaritia’s table progression. Fill a 3×3 grid with nine ordinary crafting tables to make a Compressed Crafting Table.

Continue with the Double Compressed Crafting Table, then the specialised Sculk, Nether and End tables, and finally Extreme. Follow each recipe’s category and tier; the word “compressed” does not itself unlock a 9×9 grid.
SOQM’s key late Avaritia recipes use EMC Core. Prepare the tables alongside the campaign’s material progression so both the required grid and its ingredients are ready.
quest.513011406C235CDC.title: Obtain 1 × Compressed Crafting Table
quest.513011417ED6EDBA.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Shield of the Earth Core (avaritia:infinity_shield). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011417ED6EDBA.title: Obtain 1 × Shield of the Earth Core
quest.5130114285BDA854.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Infinity Helmet (avaritia:infinity_helmet). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130114285BDA854.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Helmet
quest.51301148F20F1359.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Infinity Mace (avaritia:infinity_mace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301148F20F1359.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Mace
quest.5130114AEE1EEE9F.quest_desc: An Infinity Ingot combines Crystal Matrix Ingots, Neutron Ingots, Infinity Catalysts and EMC Core on Avaritia’s 9×9 table. Preparing repeatable catalyst production alongside neutron materials is the demanding part.
Treat the Infinity Catalyst recipe as a production plan of its own: establish its required singularities and other components before requesting final ingot batches.
Keep the first ingot for the Main Route’s finale until its inventory check completes. Item objectives do not consume it; afterwards, use the material for your chosen equipment.
quest.5130114AEE1EEE9F.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Ingot
quest.51301150A4E4DACB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Sword of the Cosmos (avaritia:infinity_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301150A4E4DACB.title: Obtain 1 × Sword of the Cosmos
quest.513011562B7C92EA.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Infinity Elytra (avaritia:infinity_elytra). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011562B7C92EA.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Elytra
quest.51301163B5422470.quest_desc: Fill a 3×3 grid with nine Neutron Piles to make a Neutron Nugget. Nine nuggets then compress into one Neutron Ingot.
Reserve some nuggets for Ultimate Stew and Cosmic Meatballs. Those recipes use nuggets specifically, so the entire supply need not remain compressed into ingots.
quest.51301163B5422470.title: Obtain 1 × Neutronium Nugget
quest.51301169390FCFD0.quest_desc: A Neutron Ingot uses 9 Neutron Nuggets, or 81 Neutron Piles. Evaluate collector throughput at that full cost when estimating how long a batch will take.
Ingots feed the Neutronium Compressor, gears and Infinity Ingots. Keep a small reserve for the production line itself so spending the last ingot does not delay its next upgrade.
quest.51301169390FCFD0.title: Obtain 1 × Neutronium Ingot
quest.5130116C6474BE0E.quest_desc: A Neutronium Collector gradually produces Neutron Piles. Place it in a loaded area, wait for the first completed cycle and arrange extraction; a full working output stops useful production.
SOQM crafts the collector on the 9×9 table using Crystal Matrix, iron, quartz and redstone blocks, plus EMC Core. This is passive neutron-material production, separate from Mekanism reactors.
Test one collector and your ingot demand before mass construction. Account for material compression: 9 piles → 1 nugget, 9 nuggets → 1 ingot.
quest.5130116C6474BE0E.title: Obtain 1 × Neutronium Collector
quest.5130116C9E28AC95.quest_desc: Diamond Lattice combines diamonds with Netherite Scrap. The installed Re-Avaritia provides a tier-1 recipe using 4 diamonds and 1 scrap, plus an ordinary 3×3 recipe using 8 diamonds and 1 scrap.
Compare the available tables before making a large batch: a prepared specialised workshop reduces diamond consumption. Lattices feed Crystal Matrix Ingots and later equipment tiers.
quest.5130116C9E28AC95.title: Obtain 1 × Diamond Lattice
quest.5130118925371479.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Densest Neutronium Collector (avaritia:densest_neutron_collector). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118925371479.title: Obtain 1 × Densest Neutronium Collector

quest.5130118D15404A4E.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Boots

quest.51301198971E6A0E.title: Obtain 1 × Crossbow of the Inferno

quest.51301198EC7D0BCB.title: Obtain 1 × Infinity Chestplate
quest.5130119CA3A263C4.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dense Neutronium Collector (avaritia:dense_neutron_collector). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130119CA3A263C4.title: Obtain 1 × Dense Neutronium Collector
quest.513011A57FF0D1B0.quest_desc: SOQM simplifies Ultimate Stew into a production bundle: 4 Golden Carrots, 2 Mana Pearls, 1 Neutron Nugget and 1 Mythic Circuit. Combine them on an Avaritia tier-4 table; ingredient placement is unrestricted.

Take the finished product into your inventory for the quest check before using it. This recipe relies on developed Botania, neutron production and Mythic Circuits without requiring a collection of dozens of separate crops.
quest.513011A57FF0D1B0.title: Obtain 1 × Ultimate Stew
quest.513011C1CC3201F5.quest_desc: A Neutronium Compressor processes large batches of specified materials through compressor recipes, including Avaritia singularities. Check the required material, quantity and processing time for each output.
Feed a small quantity of the correct ingredient first, verify the selected recipe, then connect bulk delivery. Check the stored input and recipe lock before changing the product.
AE2 Singularities and Avaritia’s material singularities are different items. Infinity Catalyst needs the components in its current recipe, not any item named Singularity.
quest.513011C1CC3201F5.title: Obtain 1 × Neutronium Compressor
quest.513011CB9674DBF8.quest_desc: The Extreme Crafting Table provides Avaritia’s tier-4 recipes on a 9×9 grid. The table itself uses a tier-3 recipe on a 7×7 grid, so prepare an End Crafting Table first.

SOQM’s modified recipe also needs EMC Core, Crystal Matrix, Diamond Lattice, a Double Compressed Crafting Table and rare expedition components. Assemble the complete current recipe’s ingredients before crafting.
The finished table handles late recipes for the Philosopher’s Stone, Transmutation Table, Neutronium Collector and Infinity Ingot. Place component reserves nearby and leave room to remove outputs.
quest.513011CB9674DBF8.title: Obtain 1 × Extreme Crafting Table
quest.513011D673A634F6.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × World Breaker (avaritia:infinity_pickaxe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D673A634F6.title: Obtain 1 × World Breaker
quest.513011D735C27FBE.quest_desc: A Neutronium Gear uses 4 Neutron Ingots around 1 Crystal Matrix Ingot in an ordinary 3×3 grid. Prepare both material lines before batch crafting.
Gears are used in advanced collectors and compressors. Choose an upgrade first and count the previous-tier machines in its recipe; one new gear does not complete the whole upgrade.
quest.513011D735C27FBE.title: Obtain 1 × Neutronium Gear
quest.513011DD49D225FB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Infinity Totem (avaritia:infinity_totem). The items are not consumed by this task.
